tools.name: explain_cron
tools.description: Explain a cron expression in plain English, e.g. "0 9 * * 1-5" → "At 09:00, on Monday through Friday." Also returns notes on cron rules that often surprise people (day-of-month OR day-of-week, seconds field, shorthand expansion). Invalid expressions return isError with the reason. Read-only. Same en

tools.name: next_cron_runs
tools.description: List the next (or, with direction "previous", the most recent past) run times of a cron expression in an IANA time zone, DST-aware. Each run has the local time with its UTC offset, the UTC time, unix seconds and weekday. Default 5 runs, max 20; searches up to 50 years. Read-only. Same engine as GET

tools.name: cron_runs_between
tools.description: List every run of a cron expression between start and end (both inclusive) in an IANA time zone, DST-aware, oldest first. Default limit 20, max 100; truncated is true when there are more. Read-only. Same engine as GET /api/between.
